title: Femoral Artery Crossover Rates in 1000 Consecutive Radial Cath Labs Procedures.
brief_summary: Comparison of Crossover rates of Radial Cardiac Catheterizations and/or PCIs into femoral vs published literature
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients coming to the emergency room requiring Diagnostic Cardiac Catheterizations and/or Percutaneous Coronary Interventions

Exclusion Criteria:

* Cardiac Tamponade
* Cardiogenic Shock
study_population: 1000 Consecutive Patients who underwent Radial (or Ulnar) Artery Procedures in the Cardiac Cath Lab for Diagnostic Cardiac Catheterizations and/or Percutaneous Coronary Interventions.
